heading: About me
bio: I'm Hyacinth, a social media manager and creative strategist based in the Philippines. I've been marketing since I was a teenager: I started my first business at 13 and ran my own shop by 16, taking the product photos, writing the captions, and answering every message myself.

Since then I've led brand and growth marketing for a medical aesthetics clinic and a nail and spa salon, produced AI content for a group of beauty and wellness brands, and made social content and campaign creative for fashion, food, and e-commerce brands.
My work covers the full loop: planning the calendar, writing the brief, making the content, and reporting on what worked each month. I'm open to remote full-time, part-time, and contract roles.

skills.title: Social media management
skills.text: Account setup and profile optimization, content strategy and calendars, research and ideation, scheduling and publishing, and replying to comments and messages.
skills.help: I can take day-to-day ownership of your accounts: set up and optimize profiles, plan the content strategy and calendar, research ideas, schedule and publish, and reply to comments and messages.

skills.title: Creative production
skills.text: Static posts, carousels, and short-form video for organic content and ads. I take an idea from brief and script through design, editing, and resizing for each platform.
skills.help: I can make the content your channels run on, from static posts and carousels to short-form video for organic posts and ads. I take each idea from brief and script through design, editing, and resizing for every platform.

skills.title: UGC and influencer coordination
skills.text: Brand and creator research, outreach, campaign briefs, scripts and visual hooks, and tracking deliverables through review, by direct outreach or inside a client's influencer platform.
skills.help: I can run creator collaborations from start to finish: research brands and creators, handle outreach, write briefs, scripts, and visual hooks, and track deliverables through review, by direct outreach or inside your influencer platform.

skills.title: E-commerce support
skills.text: Product image editing in Photoshop and Lightroom, product presentation, and website listings, with close attention to fabric, color, and garment details.
skills.help: I can get your products ready to sell online: edit product images in Photoshop and Lightroom, present each product clearly, and handle website listings with close attention to fabric, color, and garment details.

skills.title: AI-assisted workflows
skills.text: Landing pages, forms, spreadsheet workflows, and simple automations built with AI tools, each one made to solve a specific day-to-day problem.
skills.help: I can use AI tools to build the small things that save your team time: landing pages, forms, spreadsheet workflows, and simple automations, each one made for a specific day-to-day problem.

skills.title: Virtual assistance
skills.text: File organization, content coordination, and admin support that keeps campaigns and teams on schedule.
skills.help: I can keep files organized, coordinate content, and handle the admin work that keeps campaigns and teams on schedule.
